name: generate_barcode
description: Generate a barcode image of the specified type encoding the given data. Returns the image as base64-encoded content.

arguments.name: barcode_type
arguments.desc: Barcode symbology (e.g. QR or Code128 or DataMatrix or EAN13 or PDF417 etc.). Use list_barcode_types for all existing values. Only one value should be passed.

arguments.name: data
arguments.desc: Data to encode in the barcode

arguments.name: image_format
arguments.desc: Output format: PNG (default) or JPEG or SVG or GIF or TIFF.

arguments.name: text_location
arguments.desc: Text position: Below or Above or None. Default depends on barcode type

name: recognize_barcode
description: Recognize barcodes of a specific type(s) from a base64-encoded image bytes. Allows specifying barcode types and recognition quality. For one-shot recognition, base64-encode the image bytes and call recognize_barcode with image_data set to the raw base64 string. Use barcode_type=QR for QR-only

arguments.name: barcode_type
arguments.desc: Types to look for (e.g. QR, Code128). Use list_barcode_types for all existing values. Default: most commonly used types. For many types checking use comma-separated values.

arguments.name: recognition_mode
arguments.desc: Quality vs speed: Fast or Normal (default) or Excellent

name: scan_barcode
description: Automatically detect and read most common barcodes in a base64-encoded image without specifying barcode type.  For one-shot recognition, base64-encode the image bytes and call scan_barcode with image_data set to the raw base64 string.

name: list_barcode_types
description: List all supported barcode types for generation and recognition.
